profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Allstate
profile.summary:
•	Excellent experience in web applications, console applications and windows forms. Design, Development and Maintenance using ASP.NET, ADO.NET, MVC ,WCF, C#, VB.NET, JAVA, Spring boot, Jenkins, JavaScript, jQuery, LINQ, XML, XSD, XSL AJAX, IIS, Oracle 11g, SQL Server 2005/2012/2016.
•	Strong experience in Object Oriented Programming (OOP).
•	Familiar with Agile Methodologies (Scrum process).
•	Experience in developing Microsoft.NET Framework 3.5, 4.0, 4.5 and 4.7.2. IntelliJ ultimate 2020, and 2022.
•	Experience with Team Foundation Server 2008, 2012 and  2015, GitHub.
•	Identify, prioritize and execute tasks in the software development life cycle.
•	Design and development of multi-tier enterprise applications applying Service Oriented Architecture, Web Services, WCF, .NET Business classes, Windows/Web Application, Microservices and REST APIs.
•	Good experience in Insurance, Marketing, Telecommunications, Factory and Financial Domains.
•	Strong understanding and experience in preparation of Dataflow diagrams, ER diagrams and Class diagrams using MS Visio. 
•	Excellent experience with Splunk, Confluence, Datadog, Lenses for Apache and Kibana.
•	Excellent knowledge of standard application architectures such Abstract Factory, Factory Method and standard software  design patterns.
•	Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
I maintain and improve legacy web application home policy system for Esurance Inc by using  C#, ASP.NET MVC and SQL SERVER 2016.

 I design, develop, test and debug new and existing microservices in macOS environment. I also create Kibana Dashboards. Experience with Spring boot, Microservices, REST API, Kibana, Jenkins, Java 8 , vault, VersionOne ultimate, IntelliJ Ultimate 2020,  Gradle, Mural and GitHub. Datadog, Lenses for Apache Kafka, Swagger UI and Apache Kafka to process streaming data.

company.name: Allstate
Esurance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I design and develop multi-tier distributed applications in a Windows/Internet environment. I maintain and enhance existing software. Additionally, I test and debug applications to identify, track and resolve defects.

Experience with SQL Server 2010 , 2012 and 2016, Visual Studio Premium 2012, 2014 and 2017, ERStudio 2008, Team explorer 2010, Jquery, LinQ, AJAX, C#, ASP.NET, MVC 4, Web Services, JavaScript, Java, framework 3.5 and 4.0, XML, XSL AND XSD, CSS and Splunk skills. Learning React, node.js, spring framework and spring boot.

Able to work effectively under pressure, independently, and within a collaborative team oriented environment using sound judgment in decision making.
